name: wrds
description: Empirical asset-pricing data from WRDS (CRSP/Compustat) and Open Source Asset Pricing: non-interactive connection, safe wrds install (no pandas downgrade), CRSP v2 conventions, market cap aggregated across share classes (permco), the CRSP-Compustat link, delisting/survivorship/microcap/Newey-West standards, and OpenAP object conventions. A data plugin for building and independently verifying asset-pricing samples.
